replies.author: Spartemex
replies.body:
I'm sorry, but this evidence is insufficient. For hacking you would need video evidence. For all we know, that could have been after a game, or he could have jumped off of a skybridge out of view.

Thanks for reporting anyways, and keep up the good work! :)
